description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.
  

  

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment Bank, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. * Develops secure and high\-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions using cloud\-native, microservices\-based application

* Continuously update technologies and patterns. Design and build solutions that avoid single points of failure
* Design and build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions using modern architectural patterns
**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience
* Proficiency with modern front\-end stacks: JavaScript or Typescript, using React or frameworks
* Ability to independently solve design and functionality challenges with minimal supervision
* Understanding of modern design patterns used in JavaScript
* Knowledge and experience working with HTML5, CSS, and pre\-compilers like Sass and LESS
* Experience with agile development methodologies and understanding of the software development life cycle
* Solid understanding of UI/UX principles, accessibility, and responsive design.
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI\-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS).
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
* Strong soft skills, including presentation, negotiation, mentoring, and stakeholder management
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* Ability to drive broader impact by sharing and contributing best practices

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability across enterprise\-scale environments
* Proficiency in Java for back\-end application development, including experience with modern frameworks and object\-oriented design principles

* Collaborate closely with product management, architecture, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Evaluate emerging engineering tools and modern frameworks to recommend architectural and operational enhancements.

* 3\+ years of experience in frontend and API development, including hands\-on experience with React, HTMX, JavaScript, Golang, RESTful API development, Docker/Kubernetes, and .NET/C\#
* 1\+ years of experience utilizing OpenAI technologies or AI\-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Claude) within software engineering workflows

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines and data integration processes
* Experience building enterprise\-scale cloud\-native applications and microservice architectures

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
